title: Worauf könnte die Veränderung reagiert haben?
observableEvidence: observed change described without coach intent as fact
functional link between prior problem and change
requiredForStrong: states a functional link or explicitly denies one
names a plausible alternative without collapsing to coaching fact
commonFailureModes: coach changed the system as fact
scoreboard as sole proof of adjustment
fairnessNote: Excellent means excellent hypothesis discipline for THIS drill — naming uncertainty and alternatives is rewarded.
